patterns.title: Fastener selection and service access
patterns.use_when: A permitted decorative prototype uses screws, inserts, captive nuts or printed threads.
checklist: Choose a fastening mechanism against actual hardware dimensions, assembly access, available tools and anticipated service cycles.
Separate alignment from retention; inspect bearing, pull-through, edge breakout, insert or thread pull-out, clamping relaxation and layer direction.
Dimension a representative mating coupon and record exact hardware, filament, orientation and process before generalizing fit.
Provide a reversible assembly path and tool access. Do not prescribe heat-set temperatures or hole sizes without the selected hardware and filament data.

patterns.title: Material, orientation and sustained service
patterns.use_when: Choosing a material or changing a design's process, environment or loading.
checklist: Record exact filament grade, condition, intended temperature/humidity/sunlight exposure and duty; use the supplier's data rather than generic material tables.
Evaluate orientation, shell continuity and sustained-load creep separately from initial stiffness or a short fit test.
Inspect bed contact and first-layer regions in the actual slicer. Geometric connectivity alone does not establish a continuous first layer.
Treat material or setting changes as new evidence scopes; preserve failed trials as well as successes.

upstream_observations.scope: Source-reported 196 mm PETG lattice on textured PEI with channels reaching the bed.
upstream_observations.claim: The author reports repeated peeling of a fragmented first layer.

upstream_observations.scope: Source-reported revision of that lattice with a sill and flared foot.
upstream_observations.claim: The author reports successful printing, not a universal rule that all separated feet fail.

limitations: No generic strengths, creep life, temperatures, shrinkage compensation, hinge endurance or food-contact advice is imported.
Material choice does not establish safety or eliminate environmental testing.

patterns.title: Review measured geometry against intended behavior
patterns.use_when: Reviewing a new design or revision after export.
checklist: Trace each requirement to a measurement, geometry-derived view, documented observation or explicitly unverified residual.
Review actual assembled and section/joint views, not only an isometric thumbnail; use measurements rather than pixels for dimensions.
Check assembly/service order, joint engagement, stops, tool access and movement envelopes, recording poses and unresolved collision checks.
Report severity, part/interface location, evidence and suggested correction. Do not present an author's self-review as independent validation.
limitations: No mandatory agent launch, budget, renderer, universal nozzle multiplier or untested clearance is adopted.
A review checklist is not a mechanical, slicer or physical test.
